title: Latency-Response Theory Model: Evaluating Large Language Models via Response Accuracy and Chain-of-Thought Length
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing a psychometric model (LaRT) to evaluate the reasoning performance of Large Language Models on mathematical benchmark datasets like MATH500 and AIME. The evaluation metrics are strictly limited to response accuracy and chain-of-thought length; there is no analysis or component dedicated to religion, morals, or ethics.
